_doc: W13 golden eval dataset — SINGLE SOURCE for (a) the hermetic CI regression gate and (b) the committed-not-applied seed migration. Cognition goldens per archetype (CTO decision D1): the 5 v1 incidents stay harness regressions; this dataset verifies tier/tool cognition. 'fingerprints' is blessed from eval-fingerprint.evalFingerprints() — a prompt/model/tool edit flips it and forces this fixture to be regenerated (re-bless). 'responses' is the (case_id → model → scripted LLM turns) cache so the gate is deterministic with no live LLM. Carteira cases are expected_action (semantic) → SKIP until a later wave, so they need no cached response.
